method: Supplementary first-harmonic image diagnostic, not replacement for frozen contour identifiability or a native fit
input_split: existing color_stripes light Alert calibration only
operation: Least squares [1,cos(2pi*x/216),sin(2pi*x/216)] per RGB channel per row. Complex sum of each RGB harmonic times conjugate of reference harmonic, phase converted to apparent horizontal pixels. Preserve channel phases/spread and fit residuals; do not interpret as source-point correspondence.
limits: finite partial period and nonuniform tone/blur can bias phase
top/bottom curved masks and source folds may contaminate this descriptive measure
foreground outside the selected rows is not evaluated
not an acceptance threshold; all rows retained, no threshold tuning
only existing calibration, no holdout read
